test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'WINNER' is written as 'XJOOFS' and 'RALLY' is written as 'SBMMZ'. How will 'CARTOON' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e82b7da6e41b2a069e2db44b7b686c69a4d8afae6d389dc05a659aaeaa56953.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'WINNER' is written as 'XJOOFS' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d64324814adabb9333529453b3cfdf888f6dff5a51dce9701d702acc28bee465.png] 

And,

 'RALLY' is written as 'SBMMZ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7890a4e93cf64f900a38a38ce8ee084cc1dbca940df7a50ce056fa28de917a77.png] 

Similarly, 

**'CARTOON' is written as 'DBSUPPO'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e7b0d25730d1ccb637a7964214f8c6db60e182b00d938306eb4f075068e7bbb.png] 

Hence, **"Option 3" **is the correct answer.
